_: Every place a way stands in non-sea water deeper than 0.3 m, measured over the live water bake. Generated by `python3 -m worldgen.water_crossings` — never hand-edited. The band is set on SPAN, because no crossing in the province is deeper than the deepest row here and depth therefore never decides anything. Which of the `ferry`-band crossings actually becomes a ferry is authored in `world/sources/routes/ferry-crossings.json`, against a causal reason, not against this file.
